summary: Ran the Render npm build check and a UI regression smoke test. Clean npm build: /app/frontend was copied to /app/.npmcheck without node_modules, build, yarn.lock or package-lock.json. On Node 20.20.2 with npm 10.8.2, `npm install` succeeded (1497 packages) and `CI=false REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://example.onrender.com npm run build` compiled successfully. It produced build/index.html, and the bundle contains the backend URL. The resolved ajv is 8.20.0 at the top level, which ajv-keywords@5/schema-utils@4 need. The temp folder was deleted. UI smoke test (mobile viewport): the landing need-help-card and want-to-help-card go to /auth?role=migrant and /auth?role=helper, by mouse click and by keyboard Enter. Login as maria@teste.com works. /home showed 10 post cards, and load-more raised that to 12. /jobs, /volunteers, /nearby, /housing and /profile all render with no page errors. On /volunteers, the request card (role=button) opens /direct-chat/{user_id} and 'Criar oferta pública' opens the offer modal. On /jobs, the 'Ver no mapa completo' card goes to /nearby. Job and service list cards could not be clicked because there is no data (RAPIDAPI_KEY is missing, which was already known).

issues: The 'API key não configurada' error banner overlaps the 'Buscar Emprego' header. This was already the case because RAPIDAPI_KEY is not set.

action_items: render.yaml frontend buildCommand is 'yarn install && yarn build' with NODE_VERSION 20.18.0, but the Render service actually runs 'npm install && npm run build' on Node 22. Make them match: either point the Render dashboard at render.yaml/yarn, or update render.yaml.
No package-lock.json is committed, so npm builds on Render are not reproducible (ajv resolved to 8.20.0 here). Consider committing a lockfile for whichever package manager Render uses.
Optional: the onKeyDown handlers on role=button divs do not call preventDefault for the Space key, so pressing Space also scrolls the page.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/.npmrc has strict-ssl=false, which turns off TLS verification for npm installs (including on Render). Remove it unless it is really needed.
Several pages are over 700 lines (JobsPage.js is 1074). The same inline onKeyDown keyboard handler is repeated 16 times; move it into a shared helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The clean npm build passes on Node 20. Node 22 was not available locally, so it was not tested. The temp folder /app/.npmcheck was removed. Clickable divs on the landing page, /volunteers and the /jobs map card all work. Job/service cards in /jobs need data (RAPIDAPI_KEY or service posts) before they can be tested.
